items.en: Just act extremely conspicuous for anyone watching
"I just want to help Scylla."
"Just making our friend Finlay's work more interesting."
"I'm looking for Elissa Zal. I think she can help Scylla."
"Agent Finlay, right?"
"You don't sound like Cavin Pharoh. Or his friend."
Return to the transit hub
"A League Agent named Siyavong told me where Scylla is."
"Cavin seemed to think that you know where Scylla is."
"You have a very interesting comms system."
Have your quartermaster buy some krill paste
Don't bother.
"I think I made a convincing argument."
"Because I'm not working for MuniSec or Fleet."
"It must have been my raw charisma."
"Neither do I. But he did."
"Is this how you communicate with Scylla?"
"Does Scylla use this to carry on with her research?"
"Am I talking to a human or a simulated persona?"
"The what of who?"
"Warlord Leonis - you mean the Isirah system."
"'Isirah system' and a block of krill paste, that's all I get?"
Disconnect the comms
"What is it exactly that you do?"
"It took you long enough to contact me."
"Where is Scylla Coureuse?"
"I want to help Scylla."
"I can't disclose the reason. I intend to find her with or without your help."
"Other people seem to think she's important."
"I'm helping Provost Anahita Baird with some kind of secret project."
"I can put you in contact with Elissa Zal."
"As a demarchon of the League, you work for me. Remember?"
"I'm quite serious."
"I am... from a certain point of view."
"No, but it seems like what people like to hear."
"Obviously not."
"You're just telling me where she is?"
"How do you know about Baird?"
"And what is that?"
Transmit the comms ID of Elissa Zal
"And that's what makes the League great. Do go on."
"That's the right attitude. So where's Coureuse?"
"You're just telling me where she is?"
"What is your endgame here? Why help me?"
"Wait, I have more questions."
"I have questions about Scylla Coureuse."
"Why are you pretending you don't know me?
"Okay. I see how it is."
"Scylla. Coureuse. Remember? You told me where to find her."
"Academician Coureuse. You questioned people who know her."
"As a demarchon of the Persean League, I demand you answer me."
Investigate the probe
Get a sitrep from the tech team
"So who's it talking to? Where are they?"
"Fascinating. Conclusions?"
"What would this receiver look like?"
"Did you happen to find a probe belonging to the Galatia Academy?"
"I have all the time in the world."
"Perhaps a 'donation' could help speed things along."
"I'm authorized to recover Academy property- by force, if necessary."
"I'll transfer those credits to speed things along." (bribe)
"Actually, I have all the time in the world." (wait)
"Don't test me. I will use force to recover Galatia Academy property if necessary."
"Conclusions?"
"Let's talk about this."
"You're right, I do serve Moloch..." (bluff)
"What information is that?"
"Let's talk about making a deal."
"Who exactly is this employer?"
"I don't respond well to threats."
"You'll get nothing from me."
Decline the deal
Accept the deal
"No, I mean how much will it cost for you to forget that I exist?"
"Not even for 50,000 credits?"
"Let's talk about something else..."
"Let's talk about you bribing me, then."
"How about 100,000 credits?"
"Let's talk about you bribing me, then."
"Then you'll get nothing from me."
"That's it? You're just going to leave?"
Tell Baird that Coureuse is in the Isirah system
Search the station for a makeshift hypercomm receiver
"Then you know what to look for. Make it happen."
"Do it."
Search the station for the source of the mysterious signals
"If there was a hypercomm relay here, how would we find it?"
"Make it so."
"I'm looking for someone called Scylla Coureuse."
"Let's talk about credits."
"I'm one of you, you can work with me. I've got a reputation."
"Because uh, Warlord Kanta said so?"
"Let's talk about Scylla Coureuse again, instead."
"You can count on it, friend."
"I do like to keep informed."
"Wait, are you some kind of Pather?"
"What do you think it is?"
"Please, go on."
"I don't need any ghost stories. Enjoy your drinks." (leave)
"How do you know the interference is coming from Groombridge?"
"I thought you said it wasn't a natural source."
"And what business is that?"
"Then I've come to the right person."
"Not interested. See you around."
"I already talked to the boss of Kapteyn and got the information."
"Doesn't that cut you out of the loop? What about your profit?"
"Thanks for the tip. Enjoy your drink."
"I still need more on Coureuse. Can you help?"
"Thanks. Enjoy your drink."
Pay the credits
"I'll figure it out myself. Enjoy your drink."
"Do you have proof? Documentation?"
"This is very important." (explain)
"No, I'm not looking for a ship. She's a person."
"Um. Thank you for your time."
"I'm looking for a Scylla Coureuse."
"Right, of course. I'll be back with those."
"Wait, what's this about a secret warehouse?"
"I'm going to have to insist!" (bluff)
"I'm a fellow demarchon of the League. We need to work together."
"Do you know anything about the Galatia incident?"
"I know Coureuse is on this station and I can prove it."
"Archon. Let's talk about Coureuse, and the evidence you require..."
DEV set various PL flags
"Have you ever met Reynard Hannan?"
"I understand. The Persean League blockaded my colonies to force me to join."
"I'm sorry you feel that way. Let's discuss something else."
"And is he not the most proud, insufferable bully you've ever met?"
"Don't you want to be like him? His success, his power?"
"He's extorting me for League membership. Payments directly to Gens Hannan."
"I told Reynard I'd join the League to vote him out of office. Would you help?"
"I told Reynard to his face that his disregard for human life is unbelievably cynical."
"I beat Reynard at his own game. I joined the League, but on my terms."
"So will you help me?"
"I guess that's our lot. Shall we discuss something else?"
Tell the archon about the Pather cell operating on Laicaille
Tell the archon about the secret hypercomms relay on Groombridge station
Tell the archon how easily you discovered information on the intel operation on Laicaille
Tell the archon about the 'comm intercepts' to Laicaille from a 'radical agitator' on Fikenhild
"I'll come back when I have something for you."
"And I can prove it."
"I'm looking for Scylla Coureuse. She was involved."
"Do you think something like that could happen here?"
"I have proof that Scylla Coureuse is on this station."
"Good to know. I'll rest easy."
"What if Coureuse is on this station - right now?"
"I'll be back when I can prove it."
Tell the Archon about the Pather cell operating here
Tell the Archon about the secret hypercomms relay on Groombridge station
Tell the Archon that you know about the League's intel operation here
Tell the Archon about the comm intercepts to here from a radical on Fikenhild
"Let me see Coureuse. You don't owe the Persean League anything."
"Orders from Kazeron? I can see who really runs Laicaille."
"She is a free citizen of the League. Does that mean nothing?"
"Fair enough. Sorry for prying."
"I am?"
"You don't?"
Install and run the snoop algorithm
"Which is?"
"Who am I looking at?"
Meet the Archon and visit the safehouse of Scylla Coureuse
Follow the archon
Watch what happens
"Scylla Coureuse, I presume."
"A gift from Elissa."
"I have a message for you."
Give her Baird's message on your datapad
"Great. Let's go."
"What did Baird say?"
"Well. Let's go, then."
Open a channel
Pretend you didn't see
Wave back to Sebestyen
Board the transport pod
"I don't think the Persean League will be happy to lose Coureuse."
"She doesn't like you, does she."
"Are you... watching my accounts?"
"You're obviously trying to re-open the Gates."
"What happened? Weren't you the archon of Laicaille?"
"This seems unjust. Is there anything I can do?"
"Are they going to come after me next?"
"My condolences. I must be on my way." (cut comm link)
"This is unjust. Is there anything I can do?"
"You look familiar..."
"Aren't you a little young for an archon?"
"You're new. What happened to the old archon?"
"If you don't like it here, why don't you resign?"
"This post must be a terrible burden. Thank you for your service." (sarcastic)
"This post must be a terrible burden. Thank you for your service."
"Interesting. Well, keep up the good work." (leave)
"Demarchon. Not captain. I lead a member-polity in the League."
"This must be terrible for you. Thank you for your service." (sarcastic)
"This must be terrible for you. Thank you for your service."
Inform the agent that the Provost is expecting you for a meeting
"However?"
"Do you have any other leads?"
"Do you have any idea what this research was for?"
"Gargoyle, do you have more information?"
"I've got everything I need."
"Can you help me find Kelise Astraia?"
"What was that you were saying about 'Project Ziggurat'?"
"Good. So you can help?"
"I'll be honest, that was a little underwhelming."
"I would like to hear about what you found, Gargoyle."
"If you just want to whine about it, I can be on my way."
Just wait
"I value your expertise."
Keep waiting
"You've given me a lot to think about."
Ask for help getting info on Kelise Astraia
"What kind of favor?"
"You want my help to run a convoluted disinformation campaign."
"But you did take part in the conspiracy."
"Why are you leaking evidence against yourself?"
"Sure."
"No. But I'll do it if you want."
"This seems unlikely to work."
"How about some credits to help this job along?"
Offer to sell Arroyo's fake blackmail material
"Brave words for someone without a warfleet behind them."
"Oh no. Anything but that. Transmitting now."
Insist on payment
"You're going to pay me $gaPZ_paymentForCommFakes credits."
"Transferring data now."
"Can you tell me more about the Hamatsu?"
"But what?"
Ask about Kelise Astraia
"We're just networking, right? Let me add you on Tri-link... "
"Perhaps a generous finder's fee would smooth things along?"
Make an excuse and close the comm link
"Of course. And this fee would come to... ?"
"All things considered, you don't think... " (negotiate)
Make some excuse and close the comm link
"Do I know you?"
"I wish to repent and follow the Path of Ludd."
"Shields up!" (end)
"Perhaps half that amount would be sufficient?"
Transfer the tithe
"No deal. Shields up!" (end)
Ask about the Hamatsu
"It is."
"How'd you know?"
"...You don't sound very quiet."
"I need to find out where Kelise Astraia went."
"I'll find it."
"I can't make any promises."
